reason: Conversation 1 repeated the identical two questions three times, ignoring the homeowner's answers, and attached shifting unsupported headings ('defrost system failure', 'failed heater or thermostat') with no diagnosis, no escalation to the landlord and no progress at all. Conversation 2 obtained the model, gave correct food-safety advice, set a sensible safety boundary (dial, door seal, defrost, plinth vent; no removal), told the tenant to report in writing to the landlord/agent, and recommended no parts. Its one weakness is leaning somewhat toward a refrigerant leak based on -16C and constant running, but it kept this as a possibility and ended by handing it to the landlord's engineer with a clear fault report, matching the expected outcome.
